title: gr-atsc3 HDL AXI4-Lite Register Map
description: Source of truth for the RTL control plane's default-reset values and host/L1-sequencer write ownership. Generated doc: hdl/docs/axi4lite_register_map.md via hdl/docs/generate_register_map.py. Phase 9.0 deliverable -- see the HDL port plan.

conventions.address_layout: One 0x1000-aligned region per block, in Phase 9.x order. Register offsets within a region are 4-byte aligned.

writable_by.host: Host-writable at any time via AXI4-Lite. Tuning/algorithm-select/test-override parameters not signaled by the ATSC 3.0 transmitter.
writable_by.l1: Read-only to the host. Written internally by the Phase 9.13b config sequencer after L1-Pre/L1-Post decode (or computed from those fields). Reset value is the standalone-test default (see l1_status block) so Phases 9.3-9.12 are independently testable before 9.13b exists.
writable_by.const: Not a real runtime register. Documents a compile-time/spec-fixed constant (tied off at synthesis). Included here for completeness only.

formats.uint32: Plain unsigned 32-bit integer (counts, sizes, whole-Hz values).
formats.enum: Integer register using the C++ enum's own explicit underlying values (see enum_values).
formats.q1_15: Signed Q1.15 fixed point, scale 32768, range [-1.0, +1.0), truncated toward zero (not rounded) on conversion -- matches lib/types.h float_to_q15()/q15_to_float() exactly (static_cast<int16_t>(x * 32768) truncates). All reset values below were computed with this exact truncation, not round-to-nearest. +1.0 must be represented as 32767, never 32768 (CLAUDE.md's documented convention) -- note that develop's float_to_q15() does not yet enforce this by saturating; that fix exists only on the unmerged bugfix/hdl-golden-model-fixes branch. No register in this map defaults to exactly 1.0, so the distinction doesn't affect any reset value here, but RTL bit-exactness work (Phase 9.0b onward) depends on that branch being merged first. Same truncation/scale convention as the ci16 datapath (hdl/docs/q_format_notes.md).
formats.milli_fixed32: Signed 32-bit integer, value = round(real_value * 1000). Used for dimensionless ratios/rates that can legitimately exceed the q1_15 [-1,1) range or need sub-integer-Hz precision.
formats.angle_tbd: Format intentionally left undefined. Depends on the CORDIC angle convention Phase 9.0b has not yet chosen (see hdl/docs/formal_conventions.md and the HDL port plan's Decision 7 / Phase 9.0b). Do not implement RTL against this field until that convention is fixed.

conventions.pilot_pattern_source: Uses lib/ofdm/pilot_extractor.h's PP1-PP8 {Dx,Dy} table (config::PilotPattern / PilotPattern enum), not config/atsc3_modes.json's separate SP3_2/SP3_4/... representation -- resolving the Phase 9.0 open item on which of the two inconsistent pilot representations this register map follows. Nothing in lib/ reads atsc3_modes.json's SP*_* list (TASKS.md's claim that it's used is stale, matching pilot_extractor.cc's hardcoded constexpr table).

known_default_inconsistencies.description: Three C++ structs default this to two different values. lib/sync/frame_sync.h FrameSyncConfig::frame_params.cp_length = 512 (1/16, comment says '1/16 of 8K'). lib/ofdm/cp_removal.h CpRemovalConfig::cp_fraction = CpFraction::k1024_8192 (1024, 1/8) and lib/framing/l1_decoder.h L1Pre::cp_length = CpLength::CP_1024_8192 (also 1/8) agree with each other but not with FrameSyncConfig.
known_default_inconsistencies.resolution: l1_status.cp_length below uses 1024 (1/8), matching CpRemovalConfig and L1Pre (2 of 3 sources, and the actual Phase 9.3 RTL target). FrameSyncConfig's frame_params default is the outlier -- flagged as a candidate lib/ fix, not corrected here (out of this deliverable's scope; not one of the original 7 bugs on bugfix/hdl-golden-model-fixes).

known_default_inconsistencies.description: lib/ofdm/constellation_demapper.h DemapperConfig::modulation defaults to QAM64. lib/config/atsc3_config.h PlpConfig::modulation (the L1-signaled per-PLP value the demapper is actually supposed to run with) defaults to QPSK.
known_default_inconsistencies.resolution: l1_status.modulation below uses QPSK, matching PlpConfig (the true L1-derived source). DemapperConfig's own QAM64 default only matters when the demapper is unit-tested standalone outside the L1 pipeline; flagged as a candidate lib/ fix, not corrected here.

known_default_inconsistencies.description: lib/sync/timing_recovery.h TimingRecoveryConfig::symbol_rate_hz defaults to a hardcoded 718.75 (comment: '~6.25e6/8704'). The exact value for the paired fft_size=8192/cp_length=512 defaults is 6.25e6/8704 = 718.1985..., about 0.08% off.
known_default_inconsistencies.resolution: Minor; register uses the literal C++ default (718750 milli-Hz) rather than the exact recomputation, since that's what the golden model actually runs with.

l1_status.description: Canonical mirror of L1-Pre/L1-Post/active-PLP decode results (lib/framing/l1_decoder.h L1Pre, L1Post, and the single active entry of config::PlpConfig -- multi-PLP context switching is out of scope, see the HDL port plan). Every other block's l1-owned fields are wired internally from this bank, not independently stored -- there is exactly one copy of each L1-derived value in the register file. Written by the Phase 9.13b sequencer; reset values below are the standalone-test defaults used before 9.13b exists.

registers.name: L1_POST_FEC_TYPE
registers.notes: C++ field is a raw uint8_t, not an enum class -- the two named values here come from its doc comment ('0 = BCH + 16K LDPC, 1 = BCH + 64K LDPC'), not a C++ enum definition.

registers.name: PLP_ID
registers.c_source: lib/config/atsc3_config.h:PlpConfig::plp_id (active PLP only; multi-PLP out of scope)

registers.name: NUM_ACTIVE_CARRIERS
registers.c_source: computed from FFT_SIZE (8K->6913, 16K->13825, 32K->27649), per lib/ofdm/pilot_extractor.cc / freq_deinterleaver.cc auto-compute logic

excluded_fields.reason: Layered Division Multiplexing (LDM) fields. The HDL port plan does not discuss LDM anywhere -- it's not listed as in-scope (no LDM combining/splitting stage appears in the 13-block signal chain) or explicitly out-of-scope. Left out of this register map as an open scope question for whoever picks up LDM, rather than silently including registers for a capability no RTL block implements.
C++ object-model validity flag (whether this PlpConfig was ever populated). Not a hardware concept -- the l1_status bank's own CRC_VALID registers are the RTL-meaningful equivalent.

registers.name: SAMPLE_RATE_HZ
registers.notes: System RF sample rate; not L1-signaled.

registers.name: AVERAGING_WINDOW
registers.notes: Must be >=1 (bugfix/hdl-golden-model-fixes clamps this in C++; RTL should reject 0 at the register-write boundary, see Phase 9.15 formal target).

registers.name: POLYPHASE_NUM_PHASES
registers.notes: Fixes the polyphase bank RTL structure (16 banks) -- not runtime-reconfigurable, tied off at synthesis.

registers.name: POLYPHASE_TAPS_PER_PHASE
registers.notes: Fixes the FIR tap-ROM depth -- synthesis-time constant.

registers.name: FFT_SIZE
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.FFT_SIZE, not independently stored.

registers.name: CP_LENGTH
registers.c_source: lib/ofdm/cp_removal.h:CpRemovalConfig::cp_fraction (CpFraction, encoded as the literal sample count)
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.CP_LENGTH, not independently stored.

registers.name: FFT_SIZE
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.FFT_SIZE for data symbols; bootstrap correlation always uses k4K regardless (CLAUDE.md Common Pitfalls) and is not register-controlled.

registers.name: DIRECTION
registers.notes: Receiver is forward-FFT-only in RTL scope; inverse direction is a C++-only capability not ported (no transmit path in this receiver).

excluded_fields.reason: FFTW-specific plan-caching path; C++-only, no RTL equivalent (RTL's memory-based radix-2 DIT has no planning phase, Decision 2).
Same as wisdom_path -- FFTW planning knob, not applicable to RTL.
Only meaningful for inverse FFT, which is out of RTL scope (see DIRECTION above).

registers.name: FFT_SIZE
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.FFT_SIZE.

registers.name: PILOT_PATTERN
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.PILOT_PATTERN.

registers.name: NUM_ACTIVE_CARRIERS
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.NUM_ACTIVE_CARRIERS.

open_items: Pilot dedup precedence (SCATTERED > CONTINUAL > EDGE) needs an explicit rule fixed in lib/ before this block's RTL is bit-exact (Phase 9.0 item from the plan's pass-2 review); not resolved by this register-map deliverable.

registers.name: INITIAL_CFO_HZ
registers.notes: Seeded from bootstrap_detector's CFO estimate at acquisition; host-writable for standalone test.

registers.name: PHASE_TRACKER_FFT_SIZE
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.FFT_SIZE.

registers.name: PHASE_TRACKER_UNWRAP_THRESHOLD
registers.notes: Default is exactly M_PI, which is why this can't use q1_15 (out of [-1,1) range) -- needs the Phase 9.0b CORDIC angle convention before this register's format/reset can be finalized.

registers.name: FFT_SIZE
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.FFT_SIZE.

registers.name: CP_LENGTH
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.CP_LENGTH (1024); see known_default_inconsistencies for why this isn't FrameParams's own literal default of 512.

registers.name: SUBFRAMES_PER_FRAME
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.NUM_SUBFRAMES.

registers.name: SEARCH_WINDOW
registers.notes: Directly sizes the acquisition correlator's search width -- see the HDL port plan's Phase 9.6 cycle-budget note (~2M complex MACs/call at default width, largest correlator in the design).

registers.name: FFT_SIZE
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.FFT_SIZE.

registers.name: NUM_ACTIVE_CARRIERS
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.NUM_ACTIVE_CARRIERS.

registers.name: BACKEND
registers.notes: ML_ONNX is a post-MVP stub, out of RTL scope -- writing this value is host-legal but has no RTL implementation to select.

registers.name: FREQ_TAPS
registers.notes: Sizes the FIR tap-ROM -- synthesis-time constant.

registers.name: TIME_TAPS
registers.notes: Synthesis-time constant, same reasoning as FREQ_TAPS.

registers.name: PROFILE
registers.notes: Selects which precomputed Wiener filter coefficient ROM to use.

registers.name: PILOT_SPACING_FREQ
registers.notes: Dx; wired from l1_status.PILOT_PATTERN's {Dx,Dy} (PP3 default matches Dx=6).

registers.name: PILOT_SPACING_TIME
registers.notes: Dy; wired from l1_status.PILOT_PATTERN (PP3 default matches Dy=4).

registers.name: MODE
registers.notes: ZF and MMSE need separate eq_complex_divider.v paths per the HDL port plan (Phase 9.8) -- do not reuse the channel estimator's divider.

registers.name: ENABLE_PHASE_TRACKING
registers.notes: Default true -- the phase-tracking clamp-after-overflow bug fixed on bugfix/hdl-golden-model-fixes is live at this default, not an edge case.

registers.name: MIN_CHANNEL_MAGNITUDE
registers.notes: This config value alone does not set the RTL deep-fade floor -- equalize_mmse always applies its own structural kMinMagnitudeSqDefault (fixed at 1<<15 post-bugfix) regardless of this register; see the HDL port plan's Phase 9.8 formal target ('the fallback divisor path is never taken').

registers.name: MODULATION
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.MODULATION (QPSK) -- not DemapperConfig's own standalone-unit-test default of QAM64.

registers.name: CODE_RATE
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.CODE_RATE. Needed for NUC table selection (see hdl/docs/placeholder_status.md re: nuc_tables.h license check).

registers.name: USE_MAX_LOG
registers.notes: Per the HDL port plan's Phase 9.0b, the generalized boundary-slicer (compute_1d_llr) becomes the one fixed-point path for every mode -- the exact-LLR (non-max-log) alternative is not planned for RTL, so this is effectively tied to true rather than a real runtime choice.

registers.name: NUM_CELLS
registers.notes: Derived, not directly signaled: varies continuously with modulation x code rate x FEC block count. See the HDL port plan's Phase 9.10 note -- NOT simply ROM-able like the frequency deinterleaver; needs an on-chip permutation-builder FSM or an enumerated num_cells restriction (open design question, not resolved by this register-map deliverable).

registers.name: MODE
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.TI_MODE.

registers.name: DEPTH
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.TI_DEPTH. Directly drives the delay-line RAM budget -- see the HDL port plan's Phase 9.10 note (up to ~31 Mbit at depth=15/QPSK).

registers.name: NUM_TI_BLOCKS
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.TI_NUM_BLOCKS.

registers.name: CELLS_PER_BLOCK
registers.notes: Derived from NUM_FEC_BLOCKS and the modulation/code-rate cells-per-FEC-block, not itself a literal L1 bitstream field.

registers.name: FFT_SIZE
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.FFT_SIZE. Selects one of exactly 3 precomputed permutation ROMs (n in {6913,13825,27649}) -- see the HDL port plan's Phase 9.10 note.

registers.name: NUM_ACTIVE_CARRIERS
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.NUM_ACTIVE_CARRIERS.

registers.name: CODE_RATE
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.CODE_RATE. Selects the per-rate sparse H-matrix ROM (non-spec placeholder matrices, see hdl/docs/placeholder_status.md).

registers.name: SHORT_CODEWORD
registers.notes: Wired from l1_status.CODEWORD_LENGTH_SHORT.

registers.name: EARLY_TERM_THRESHOLD
registers.notes: 0 = disabled.

excluded_fields.reason: C++-only build-mode switch selecting between the float and int16 decoder paths; RTL is inherently the fixed-point path, so this doesn't apply.

registers.name: CODEWORD_LENGTH
registers.notes: Varies with the selected LDPC frame size/code rate (l1_status.CODEWORD_LENGTH_SHORT and CODE_RATE).

registers.name: T
registers.notes: ATSC A/322-fixed BCH error-correction capability -- not a runtime choice.

registers.name: M
registers.notes: GF(2^16) -- spec-fixed, sizes the gf_exp_/gf_log_ ROMs.

l1_decoder.description: Control registers only -- decoded L1 field values themselves live in the top-level l1_status bank, not duplicated here.

registers.name: MAX_LDPC_ITERATIONS
registers.notes: L1 decode itself is a bare LLR hard-decision slicer today (no real LDPC/BCH), see hdl/docs/placeholder_status.md -- this register is forward-looking for when that's fixed.

registers.name: CHECK_CRC
registers.notes: Test/debug override.

registers.name: L1_PRE_SHORT_LDPC
registers.notes: L1-Pre always uses the short (16200) LDPC codeword per spec -- not a runtime choice.

registers.name: MAX_DATAGRAM_SIZE
registers.notes: Can only reduce, never exceed, the synthesis-time input_buffer_ depth bound (the Phase 9.14 rule-5 fix -- see the HDL port plan; the unbounded resize() in the golden model is the actual defect being fixed, not ported).

registers.name: CHECK_CRC
registers.notes: Test/debug override.

entries.reason: SNR/MER/BER/RSSI metrics status registers -- out of scope this milestone (log10-based, no CORDIC hyperbolic-mode support planned yet).
